title: Best 7 Marketing AI Agents and the free tools to build them
instagram:
7 AI agents that take marketing work off your plate. 🤖

❌ Another chatbot you have to babysit
✅ Agents that research, write and monitor for you

Here are the 7, with a free-to-start tool to build each:

1️⃣ Lead Research Agent
Your ideal customer profile in, scored leads out. Build it with n8n.

2️⃣ Cold Email Agent
A personal first line for every prospect. Build it with Clay.

3️⃣ Competitor Agent
Alerts when a competitor changes prices or copy. Build it with changedetection.io.

4️⃣ Market Research Agent
Deep research reports with citations. Build it with GPT Researcher.

5️⃣ Content Research Agent
The web as clean text to mine for ideas. Build it with Firecrawl.

6️⃣ Content Repurposing Agent
One idea into many formats. Build it as a Claude Skill with skill-creator.

7️⃣ Social Media Agent
Plans and schedules posts for your review. Build it with Postiz.

The bottom line:
5 of the 7 tools are open source. All 7 have a free way to start.
